_about: What each executive department or office oversees, for the 'Only industries they oversee' filter. Same fields as committee_industries.json; 'like' copies a committee's industry lists. The President runs the whole executive branch, so every industry counts.

XPRES.name: The President
XPRES.oversees: The whole executive branch, so every industry

XFED.name: Federal Reserve
XFED.oversees: Interest rates, banks and the financial system

XCOM.name: Commerce Department
XCOM.oversees: Trade, tariffs, export controls, telecoms, technology

XENE.name: Energy Department
XENE.oversees: Energy production, nuclear power, the power grid

XINR.name: Interior Department
XINR.oversees: Public lands, oil, gas and mining leases

XHHS.name: Health and Human Services
XHHS.oversees: Drug makers, health insurers, hospitals, food safety

XVET.name: Veterans Affairs
XVET.oversees: Veterans' health care and its suppliers

XSTA.name: State Department
XSTA.oversees: Foreign policy, arms sales, foreign aid

XJUS.name: Justice Department
XJUS.oversees: Antitrust, mergers and federal law enforcement

XEPA.name: Environmental Protection Agency
XEPA.oversees: Pollution rules for energy, chemicals and manufacturing
